name: workspace
//type: Required. The Vercel function is emitted as api/[...path].js — .js because Vercel only treats that extension as a catch-all route — and its bundled output is ESM, so the package must declare it. Safe now that the function is a single self-contained file: the earlier breakage came from unbundled imports, not from this field.

scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
